text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The Classic-class Mile Championship 
showdown! It's the NHK Mile Cup, DEESU!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's here, Trainer. The long-awaited Gâ 
we've had our sights on!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, yes! From here, El shall soar 
into the Japan Cup and into the skies of 
the world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And so, this race marks our farewell, yes.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, here the path splits completely. 
Between the Derby contenders, and El who 
takes a different road.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'd be lying if I said I didn't feel 
lonely. So... I AM lonely, death!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I have no regrets, desu! This is 
the path El chose too.”

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"There are some things you just can't do 
anything about." Someone or other said 
that once.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I won't let these tears that are 
falling carry over into the race!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El is... the world's condor! I will prove 
it in this race that Pearl-senpai also 
won, deeees!
